► Subscribe to Sky Sports News: http://bit.ly/SkySportsNewsSub

Manchester City chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak says he has "strong views" on the Premier League charges against the club.

The recent treble winners had their case referred to an independent commission by the Premier League in February after being charged with over 100 breaches of financial rules spanning from 2009/10 to 2017/18.

The club have unequivocally denied the allegations.
